data.title: Dad seeks answers  over son's killing
data.description: The father of a 20-year-old Chinese man stabbed to death in Pattaya has called for a full and impartial investigation into his son's killing, saying the family wants all available evidence examined before conclusions are drawn.

data.title: Flood plan 'must address entire watershed area'
data.description: SONGKHLA: Hat Yai's flood-prevention efforts must cover the entire watershed rather than focus solely on the city, the Hat Yai Economic Council has warned as authorities step up preparations for the rainy season.

data.title: Man under treatment after mid-air freakout
data.description: Passengers on a flight from Malaysia to Bangkok were startled by a Thai man who became agitated mid-flight and reportedly attempted to open an exit door.

data.title: Govt urges more scrutiny  of Cambodia border claims
data.description: Thailand has called on the international community to independently verify claims surrounding the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict, saying allegations should not be accepted without examining evidence from both sides.

data.title: Ex-teacher in hot water over threats
data.description: SONGKHLA: Authorities are preparing legal action against a former Hatyaiwittayalai School teacher following an online threat that prompted the school to tighten security.

data.title: Finance plan to help local communities
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has approved a 4.45-billion-baht programme to provide cheaper financing to grassroots communities and reduce their reliance on high-interest informal loans.

data.title: Govt moves to make school safety a priority
data.description: The government is preparing to make school safety a national priority, with the Education Ministry due to submit six measures to the cabinet today following last week's shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School.

data.title: Travel subsidy nears launch
data.description: The Tourism and Sports Ministry expects to finalise details of the proposed Thai Tiew Thai Plus domestic tourism subsidy scheme by next week as it seeks to launch the programme during the green (monsoon) season, Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said.

data.title: Anutin slams police treatment of suspect in PAO chief killing
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ordered the Nonthaburi governor and provincial police chief to take decisive action in the case of former MP Chalong Riewraeng allegedly shooting dead Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) president Pol Col Thongchai Yenprasert.

data.title: Chinese syndicate aide arrested in B54m crypto laundering case
data.description: A suspected right-hand man of a Chinese crime boss has been arrested in Bangkok in connection with an online fraud and money laundering network believed to have washed more than 54 million baht through cryptocurrency.

data.title: FAA ordered structural checks don't affect Thailand's 737 MAX planes
data.description: The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand said an airworthiness directive (AD) issued by the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for structural investigations of Boeing 737 MAX planes does not affect the 12 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft based in Thailand.

data.title: Police seek charges against Bangkok bar owner for deadly fire
data.description: Thai police intend to charge the owner of a Bangkok bar with six offences, including negligence, over a fire last month that killed 37 people, the lead investigator said Monday.

data.title: Former MP blames debt dispute for shooting of PAO president
data.description: Former MP Chalong Riewraeng cited a debt dispute as prompting him to fatally shoot Nonthaburi Provincial Administration Organisation (PAO) chief Thongchai Yenprasert on Monday, a senior officer said.

data.title: Miscommunication blamed for sacked foreign teacher's threatening post
data.description: SONGKHLA - The director of Hatyaiwittayalai secondary school said on Monday that miscommunication might have led to the threatening online post by a sacked foreign teacher.

data.title: 13 foreigners netted in property-nominee blitz in Hua Hin
data.description: Thirteen foreigners were arrested on Monday when police raided a housing and pool-villa estate in Hua Hin, after they were found using Thai nominee shareholders to buy properties for them.

data.title: Clothes rack falls from highrise onto taxi-motorcyclist
data.description: A clothes-drying rack fell from a highrise balcony onto a motorcycle driver and his passenger in soi Sukhumvit 24, causing the driver to swerve into a nearby car stopped in the traffic.

data.title: Chinese syndicate aide arrested in B54bn crypto laundering case
data.description: A suspected right-hand man of a Chinese crime boss has been arrested in Bangkok in connection with an online fraud and money laundering network believed to have washed more than 54 million baht through cryptocurrency.

data.title: Former MP arrested after PAO president slain
data.description: Former Nonthaburi MP Chalong Riewraeng was arrested after a man stormed into the provincial administration organisation office and shot dead the PAO president, Thongchai Yenprasert, on Monday morning.

data.title: Chiang Mai safe from flooding, more rain this week
data.description: Irrigation officials have moved to calm fears that Chiang Mai city may be flooded, stressing that the level of the Ping river, a major waterway, remains far below the crisis level.

data.title: Frenzied Thai on Malaysia-Bangkok flight an army officer with mental issues
data.description: Passengers on a flight from Malaysia to Bangkok were startled by a Thai man who became agitated mid-journey, repeatedly shouting demands for the aircraft to land and reportedly attempting to open an exit door.
